title: Kagamine Len — Even Though She's My Partner〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I have to wait until tomorrow to practice with Miku...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But whatever she needed to talk about with An and the others did seem pretty urgent...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What if Kohane said, “I want to sing with someone else”...? How would that make you feel?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's like you're not going to be partners anymore.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? Is something wrong, An?
You don't look so good...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I hope I didn't say anything that I shouldn't have there...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess I'll just head back to MEIKO's place for now. She did say that I could get whatever I want.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What should I get?
It's been a while since I last had a parfait.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, a juicy slice of peach!
Dibs!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't dig it out like that, Len.
You'll make the ice cream fall out!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That reminds me. Rin and I shared a parfait that time...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There are plenty of things that I can work on all by myself, so I'll just start with those!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (If I'm actually gonna become the best partner she can hope for, I can't let stuff all these things bother me so much!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think I'm doing pretty well for myself today. Alright, let's keep this up and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello, Len! Working hard, I see?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, what am I saying?! Where have you been all this time?! What happened to me being your apprentice?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry about that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you seem to be practicing awfully hard today. Is something going on?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm trying to... No, I'm taking things more seriously now!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you know...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
Becoming the best partner you can...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! That's why I'm practicing so hard.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And now that you know what's going on, you're gonna help me, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Hold on, I don't mind, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Great, I'll be counting on you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm gonna become better than I am now and show Rin that I'm the best partner she's ever had.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, I understand...
I'll be happy to help.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Len, sorry about...
Huh? KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Did you get to talk to An?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, a little.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sorry about leaving you like that, Len. I didn't mean to push back our practice like that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: An really didn't seem well, so I felt compelled to go see her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's okay. I'm glad you were there to help her since what I said probably caused all this.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, one more thing! KAITO agreed to join me for practice today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great, and we can practice together tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks!
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How was that?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Very good! Right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it was. You've improved quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Awesome!
Do you think Rin will be surprised?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure of it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yay...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank you both so much for helping me out like this!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I am supposed to be teaching you more, so I suppose this was just me fulfilling those duties.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, I'm gonna go find Rin and sing for her!

rows.Speaker: Miku & KAITO
rows.Line: Good luck!
